title: Decision-Aligned Value Learning for Selective Adoption of EEG Fusion in Human-Robot Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2611.34451v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) captures neural activity associated with human perception and decision-making. It provides human-robot collaboration (HRC) systems with measurable evidence for event recognition, situation assessment, and action preparation. External sensing cannot easily provide such evidence. However, the quality and complementarity of this evidence vary across samples, and existing EEG fusion methods do not explicitly determine when EEG improves a prediction. We therefore framed selective EEG use as a sample-wise incremental-value estimation problem and proposed Value Estimation and Constraint-Aware Triage for Adoption (VECTA). VECTA separates the generation of an EEG-informed Fusion prediction from the decision about whether it should replace the existing Base prediction. The framework uses system gain to quantify the loss reduction from Base to Fusion and matching gain to assess whether benefits arise from sample-match

translated_title: 面向人机协作中脑电（EEG）融合选择性采用的决策对齐价值学习
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）能够捕捉与人类感知和决策相关的神经活动，为人机协作（HRC）系统提供用于事件识别、态势评估和行动准备的可测量证据，这是外部传感手段难以提供的。然而，这类证据的质量和互补性因样本而异，现有的EEG融合方法并未明确判断EEG何时能够真正改善预测。因此，本文将EEG的选择性使用构建为一个逐样本的增量价值估计问题，并提出了价值估计与约束感知的采用决策框架（VECTA）。VECTA将EEG融合预测的生成过程与是否用其替换现有基础预测的决策过程分离开来。该框架利用系统增益来量化从基础预测到融合预测的损失降低程度，并利用匹配增益来评估收益是否来自样本匹配……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出VECTA框架，将人机协作中EEG信息的选择性采用建模为逐样本增量价值估计问题，通过分离融合预测生成与采用决策，并借助系统增益和匹配增益来判断EEG融合何时能真正改善预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes VECTA, a decision-aligned value learning framework that frames selective EEG adoption in human-robot collaboration as a sample-wise incremental-value estimation problem, decoupling fusion prediction generation from the adoption decision by using system gain and matching gain to determine when EEG fusion truly improves predictions.
